holderQuote: Salii was fascinated. However, she had more insight than some of the others. She happened to know that Dulav-ra, the Skill that had popped up in her [Appraisal]-vision, was Orjin’s personal martial art.
effectQuote: Four blows. Fire. Aura strikes—or whatever you want to call them. Energy-infused punches.

holderQuote: The counter was the hardest Orjin had ever thrown
effectQuote: A shockwave ran through the Djinni before four flaming punches tore his armored body into burning metal.

holderQuote: Orjin had used his own capstone Skill to defend himself.
effectQuote: A glowing fist met the twisting blow four times.

holderQuote: Orjin had broken nine bones and been forced to use his ultimate Skill
effectQuote: He had wounded the Stitch-man so badly that Vandum had been forced to leave Pomle for four months

holderQuote: Orjin had one ultimate Skill left that Salii knew for a fact.
effectQuote: A close-combat attack that hit you four times with such intensity and heat that it could literally burn you.
